description.value: Nancy O's is a 60-seat adult-only (19+) restaurant and bar in Prince George that has been serving the community for over 11 years. The kitchen emphasizes locally sourced ingredients and offers a broad menu spanning brunch, lunch, and dinner alongside an extensive selection of 60+ beers from around the world and locally brewed BC taps. A separately bookable private dining room with its own entrance and A/V capabilities makes it a functional stop for tour groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM phone number (250-562-8066) and address (1261 3rd Ave). The site explicitly states 'open for dine in & takeout' and lists a Vegan Menu and Gluten Friendly Menu. No bike parking, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; the private room description confirms bathrooms exist on premises.
concerns: Establishment is 19+ (no minors at any time) — relevant to family cycling groups and should be noted in the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, actively operating full-service restaurant in Prince George offering takeout, vegan/GF options, and a broad menu — a practical and appealing food stop for touring cyclists in the Central Interior.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM categorizes this as 'cafe' but the website clearly describes a full-service restaurant and licensed bar with live entertainment. The cafe tag likely underrepresents the venue; Food & Drink category is correct.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu section lists a dedicated 'Vegan Menu' and a 'Gluten Friendly Menu' as separate menu categories

wow_evidence: serving the community for over 11 years... emphasizes locally sourced ingredients
